ends.description: The page the run is on after, by its id — or unknown

at.description: Only when failed: the step the method stopped at

message.description: What LinkedIn said, word for word: a notice, an error, an empty state

evidence.description: What the page showed, in LinkedIn's terms

member.description: The member the conversation is with; null for a group conversation

name.description: The heading of the conversation's header

url.description: The member's profile address the header links to, https://www.linkedin.com/in/<id>/

group.description: The group's name when the conversation is a group, with its member count: Lowgular | AI-Native Marketing (9 members)

messages.description: The messages the pane shows, oldest first

mine.description: Whether the signed-in member sent it

when.description: The date the pane last showed above it and the time beside it, as shown: Oct 12 2:52 PM, Friday 5:06 PM
